# 第三方登录

## OpenAPI Specification

```yaml
openapi: 3.0.1
info:
  title: ''
  description: ''
  version: 1.0.0
paths:
  /POST https://qiyukf.com/platform/api/openapi/merchant/account/login:
    post:
      summary: 第三方登录
      deprecated: false
      description: |-
        接口参数说明:

        - code和shopCode必填其一，都存在的情况下，优先以code为准;

        响应参数说明:

        - 的redirectUrl可以使用一次登录，直接跳转至这个链接即可，使用一次后失效
      tags:
        - 平台电商（Platform OpenAPI）
      parameters:
        - name: appKey
          in: query
          description: 企业的appKey，0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
          required: true
          example: '{{appKey}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: time
          in: query
          description: 当前 UTC 时间戳，从 1970 年 1 月 1 日 0 点 0 分 0 秒开始到现在的秒数,1463217187
          required: true
          example: '{{time}}'
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: checksum
          in: query
          description: >-
            SHA1(appSecret + md5 + time),
            三个参数拼接的字符串，进行SHA1哈希计算，转化成16进制字符(String，小写).示例2f13932c4b7c6888b12360a85261a11b8b543f64 
          required: true
          example: '{{checksum}} '
          schema:
            type: string
      requestBody:
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                userName:
                  type: string
                  description: 登录的平台所属企业中的账号
                code:
                  type: string
                  description: >-
                    登录平台所属企业code，商户二级域名前缀，商户登录域名为qiyu_merchant.qiyukf.com，code即为qiyu_merchant
                shopCode:
                  type: string
                  description: >-
                    登录平台所属企业shopCode，商户二级域名前缀‘_’后的内容，商户登录域名为qiyu_merchant.qiyukf.com，shopCode即为merchant
              required:
                - userName
                - code
                - shopCode
            example:
              userName: qiyu_merchant@163.com
              code: qiyu_merchant
              shopCode: merchant
      responses:
        '200':
          description: ''
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  code:
                    type: integer
                    description: 返回状态码，见状态码表
                  result:
                    type: object
                    properties:
                      redirectUrl:
                        type: string
                    required:
                      - redirectUrl
                    description: >-
                      返回结果，一个如下对象{redirectUrl:”http://qiyu_merchant.qiyukf.com?thirdToken=ahudgsabdasbdahsbdasbdasbdu”}。直接打开对象中的url可完成一次直接登录
                  message:
                    type: string
                    description: 状态信息描述
                  total:
                    type: integer
                    description: 此处无意义
                required:
                  - code
                  - result
                  - message
                  - total
              example: "{\n\t\"code\":200,\n\t\"result\":{redirectUrl:”http://qiyu_merchant.qiyukf.com?thirdToken=ahudgsabdasbdahsbdasbdasbdu”},\n\t\"message\":\"success\",\n\t\"total\":0\n}"
          headers: {}
          x-apifox-name: 成功
      security: []
      x-apifox-folder: 平台电商（Platform OpenAPI）
      x-apifox-status: released
      x-run-in-apifox: https://app.apifox.com/web/project/605287/apis/api-10845577-run
components:
  schemas: {}
  securitySchemes: {}
servers:
  - url: http://qiyukf.com
    description: 正式环境
security: []

```
